basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and car enthusiast from the Midwest, I split my time between trading virtual items and working as a software developer. I enjoy customizing my Ford Fusion Sport and playing poker online. When I'm not working or gaming, I like watching British reality TV. I'm in a long-term relationship and usually online during evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught in programming with a focus on C++ and QtFramework. Developed skills through online courses and by working on personal projects. Has a strong understanding of in-game economies due to extensive experience in virtual item trading.
